{{dablink|For other uses of the word "metal," see [[Metal]].}}
The '''metal balls''' are a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' recovered from the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|4}}

==Appearance==
The ''ter'angreal'' appears to be a set of metal basketwork balls, one inside the other. It seems to have endlessly smaller balls inside one another.{{ref/book|8|4}}

==Use==
Any movement produces a faint musical chime of different tone every time.{{ref/book|8|4}} The use of the ''ter'angreal'' is unknown.
